title: docs(pm): the dev's writes go through the fleet tools; platform-readings records the relay's first readings
body:
Fixes #19739

Clause-②: no

## What changed

Two files, both governed (`.claude/**`, Tier S, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`).

**`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`** — where the file speaks of the dev's GitHub writes (rule 3):
- the dev's GitHub writes leave through the `scripts/pm/` write tools; in a cloud container they take the `fleet-write` relay and land as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`;
- attribution stays the session id in the text, not `user.login`; `git push` is not a REST write and does not take the relay;
- the four-write budget names `pr_create` (the relay's op for the draft PR) and `label-write` instead of the raw REST paths.

Net +1 line there, paid in place by retiring the footer-shape-per-channel rule at the file's end (old line 402): AGENTS.md's attribution paragraph states it in full (「what a body write does to the footer depends on the CHANNEL … and the ACTION … ⛔ never generalise one to another … read the body back after every write」), and the line that follows still points at that paragraph. Nothing re-wrapped; the count stays 403 (ceiling 403, headroom 0).

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`** 〈API 配额〉, two readings beside the write-pace rows:
- the relay's first live readings — run created 5 s after the dispatch, job at 17 s, the comment written at 22 s, tool wall 31 s; the `OS_FLEET_DISPATCH_START_MS` 90 s and `OS_FLEET_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_MS` 5 min ceilings unchanged (source: the closure comment on #19701, probe 2);
- `write-pace` counts a dispatch as the write, the 40-per-hour budget unchanged; `close-cards` spends one dispatch per step (the comment through `post-stamped`, the label write, the close as one `issue_patch`).

Paid in place (+2 / −2): the two red-window rows retired are restatements of their neighbours — 「红窗里 draft 翻转与 auto-merge 挂载照常走 ccr REST,⛔ 不为它们守候」 is said by rows 143–144 (「守候只给上面那几件 GraphQL-only 的,⛔ 其余一切不为配额空等」 and 「红窗里照样走 ccr REST 挂载」), and 「其余动作(评论、标签、请审、读、timeline)照常走 REST」 is row 143's 「其余一切」. Count stays 469 (ceiling 469, headroom 0).

## Landing order

⛔ Serial: PR #19737 (#19061 step ③) holds both of these files and lowers `os-dev.md`'s ceiling 403 → 402 by retiring one line there. This PR is built on `origin/main` at 544767d and lands after PR #19737 merges; it will be rebased then (expected: a clean rebase — different lines in both files — and the `os-dev.md` count landing at 402 against the lowered ceiling). Not enqueued by this dispatch. The director seat renders the `## Contract review` of record. `skip-changeset`: nothing published; this dispatch forbids label writes, so the label is the seat's to apply.

The optional `AGENTS.md` :417 clause (card item 5, Tier H) is not in this PR; the dev's reading of whether the paragraph is false without it is in the report on the card.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:两处文字。① dev agent 定义:dev 自己的 GitHub 写(报告评论、开 draft PR、打标签)一律经 `scripts/pm/` 的写工具,云容器里这些工具走 `fleet-write` 中继、以 `objectstack-fleet[bot]` 落地;`git push` 不是 REST 写、不走中继。② 平台读数表:中继首批实测(dispatch 后 5 s 建 run、17 s 起 job、22 s 评论落地、墙钟 31 s;90 s / 5 min 两个上限不动),`write-pace` 把一次 dispatch 记作一笔写(40/时不变),`close-cards` 每步一次 dispatch。行数预算在本文件内付清,各退一到两行已在别处原样陈述的规则。

**为什么改**:中继已在 `main` 上活着(探针 2 以 App 身份落地),`fleet-write` 派生会话那张卡落地后云席位不再导出任何变量;但 dev 定义里仍写着「curl 带 GITHUB_TOKEN 直写」,读数表里没有中继的任何数字。文字不改,dev 会照旧直写、以自己的用户身份落地。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改文字,不加门禁、不加钩子、不动上限。风险一:本 PR 与 PR #19737 同持两文件,本 PR 在其后落地、届时 rebase(预期无冲突,`os-dev.md` 行数落到 402 与降后上限相符)。风险二:`os-dev.md` 里 `pr_create` 是中继的 op 名,本地检出的 dev 仍走 `with-fleet.sh -- …` 直连,文字未展开这一分支。回滚 = revert 本 PR,无状态残留。

**席位意见**:(留空,席位定稿)

**你要做的**:等 PR #19737 合并后,由席位 rebase 本 PR 并出 `## Contract review`;`AGENTS.md` :417 那一句是否要加(item 5)由总监席按报告决定,不在本 PR。
